org_similarity_list.target_short_description: Helps companies work with college students / recent grads on short-term projects both to address immediate needs and improve hiring.
Handshake is a college career network that helps students and recent graduates find their next opportunity.
RippleMatch is the recruitment automation platform replacing job boards as the way Gen Z finds work.
WayUp connects students with jobs during and after college -- from summer internships to part-time gigs to full-time jobs after graduation.
Forage works with the world’s top employers to create job simulations for students to build career skills, visibility, and confidence.
Tallo provides the only end-to-end workforce talent solution based on an approach of combining science and digital technology.
CareerBuilder is an online platform specialized in HR Software-as-a-Service to help companies with the recruitment process.
Indeed is an employment-related metasearch engine for job listings.
Yello's leading talent acquisition software is used by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth businesses to attract and nurture top talent
Snagajob is the platform for hourly work, with 100 million registered hourly workers and 470,000 employer locations nationwide.
Upkey is a provider of remote career readiness and talent engagement tools for students, universities, and companies.

overview_description.description: A social media platform that allows young people to capture and showcase evidence of their skills and attributes. A Wing.Studio profile replaces the archaic concept of a CV.
